clips.title: The story
paras: In Coldridge Valley, Nori Pridedrift carries steaming Mornbrew to those facing the cold. He makes his living brewing and selling the hot drink, and hires swift couriers to deliver it while it is still warm.

Nori Pridedrift sends hot Mornbrew across the frozen reaches of Coldridge Valley. The valley's cold bites hard, and a draught of Scalding Mornbrew offers welcome warmth. Nori brews the coffee-like drink and sends it to mountaineers and freezing sentries. It must reach them while still scalding, so his couriers race against the mountain air. Nori also has only a limited supply of sturdy mugs, and expects runners to bring them back promptly.
